email.subject: Case study for the Data Scientist role at Sablewood Media
email.body:
Hi,

As discussed, the next stage for the Data Scientist role at Sablewood Media is a case study.

The attached dataset holds a sample of anonymised viewing sessions. We'd like you to build a simple churn model, explain the features you chose, and summarise what you would try next. Please send your notebook and a short write-up by Tuesday, 3 November 2026.

There's no need to spend more than four hours on it.

All the best,
Amir Haddad
Head of Data Science
